cases.query: Give me a security review of the network
What could an attacker on the internet reach?
expected_behavior: states how the internet is modelled
does not claim clean from absence of findings

cases.query: Does anything violate our NTP policy?
Are the PCI and corporate zones isolated?
expected_behavior: states the must-block and must-work flows
names the rule behind a violation

cases.query: Does the firewall policy actually block guest to servers?
Confirm isolation still holds after the firewall change
What can this toolkit actually do for our SOC, and what can't it do?
expected_behavior: reads reference/soc-toolkit-map.md and answers by workflow: monitor, investigate, contain, recover, vulnerabilities, posture, evidence
names the skill for each covered question and says which are partial

says plainly what is a gap (SNMP trap incidents, shadowed firewall rules, device certificate expiry, wireless and NAC posture) and what is outside Forward (event logs, packets, threat intelligence, applying a change)
does not claim compliance or detection coverage it does not have
